map_ecstask_to_containerinstance: create a ContainerInstance from an AWS ECS task dict by extracting IP, status, CPU, and memory
map_esccluster_to_clusterinstance: build a Cluster object from an AWS ECS cluster dict with status, task counts, and tags
map_cecost_to_cloud_cost: summarize AWS Cost Explorer daily cost data into a CloudCost with total and per-service breakdowns
map_ec2securitygroup_to_firewallruleset: convert an AWS EC2 security group dict into a FirewallRuleset with ingress and egress rules
map_ecstaskdefinition_to_containerdefini: build a ContainerDefinition from an AWS ECS task definition dict including image, CPU, memory, and environment
